# v7c — sea turtles and the North Atlantic right whale where the record places them {#sec-release-v7c}

```{r}
#| include: false
# The full chapter lives in releases/_v7c-body.qmd (the leading underscore keeps
# Quarto from rendering it on its own). It renders in the v7c book, and in every
# book once the registry lists v7c as public. Until then a restricted release
# must never reach GitHub Pages (CLAUDE.md), so the public books of the other
# releases carry only the short note below, with no link to the review host.
# doc_access() fails closed for a version the published registry does not list.
v7c_row    <- doc_version_row("v7c")
v7c_public <- nrow(v7c_row) == 1 && !is.na(v7c_row$ver[1]) &&
  identical(doc_access("v7c"), "public")
v7c_full   <- identical(doc_ver(), "v7c") || v7c_public
```

```{r}
#| label: v7c-body
#| output: asis
if (v7c_full) {
  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    here::here("releases/_v7c-body.qmd"), quiet = TRUE, envir = environment()))
} else {
  cat(
"::: {.callout-note}
## A release under review

v7c (titled v7.2) is a pre-release under review. It patches v7's sea-turtle and North Atlantic
right whale distributions where the observational record places them. Its chapter (the rules,
the evidence behind them and what moved in the scores) is published with the v7c documentation
on the signed-in review host, and appears in every version of this book once v7c is released.
:::
")
}
```
